asset_type: Centrifugal Circulation Pump (KSB Calio Syn Series)
failure_modes: Bearing Failure due to Mechanical Wear or Cavitation Erosion
Motor Winding Insulation Breakdown due to Thermal Overload
Impeller Degradation due to Hydraulic Stress and Flow Imbalance

criteria.name: Maintenance & Inspection History
criteria.description: Manually assessed score reflecting the recency, completeness, and quality of preventive maintenance and inspection records for this pump asset.
criteria.ui_label: Maintenance History Risk Score (1=Excellent/Recent PM, 10=No Record/Overdue)

criteria.name: Bearing & Mechanical Condition (Vibration)
criteria.description: Assesses mechanical degradation and bearing wear risk using Vibration_RMS, which is a primary indicator of rotor imbalance, misalignment, and cavitation erosion in centrifugal pumps.

penalties.description: Elevated bearing temperature co-occurring with high vibration indicates accelerated bearing failure progression and lubrication breakdown

criteria.name: Bearing Thermal Stress
criteria.description: Evaluates bearing thermal overload risk using Bearing_Temp_C, where elevated temperatures indicate lubrication failure, dry running, or excessive mechanical friction in the pump bearings.

penalties.description: High vibration co-occurring with elevated bearing temperature significantly accelerates wear and failure risk

criteria.name: Motor Electrical Load & Thermal Stress
criteria.description: Evaluates motor winding thermal overload and insulation degradation risk using Motor_Current_A as a proxy for electrical and thermal stress on the motor.

penalties.description: Elevated bearing temperature under high current draw indicates compound thermal stress accelerating motor winding insulation breakdown

criteria.name: Hydraulic Performance & Flow Stability
criteria.description: Assesses hydraulic degradation and impeller erosion risk by evaluating deviations in Flow_Rate_LPS and Discharge_Pressure_Bar from expected operating ranges for this pump series.

penalties.description: Abnormally low or high discharge pressure concurrent with flow deviation indicates impeller damage, blockage, or cavitation-induced hydraulic instability

criteria.name: Composite Health Index Degradation (UAHI & PAI)
criteria.description: Evaluates overall asset health degradation risk using UAHI_Score and PAI_Score, which aggregate multiple degradation signals into unified health indicators for this pump.

penalties.description: Elevated PAI_Score alongside high UAHI_Score indicates compound performance and health deterioration amplifying overall failure risk

criteria.name: Operational Criticality & Redundancy
criteria.description: Manually assessed score reflecting the operational criticality of this pump within the system, the consequence of unplanned failure, and the availability of standby redundancy.
criteria.ui_label: Asset Criticality Score (1=Low Criticality/Standby Available, 10=Critical/No Redundancy)
